newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Marriott Intl Q2 June 20 shr rises.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Marriott Intl Q2 June 20 shr rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: The companyy said that, in line with its expectations, net income for the 1997 second quarter was reduced by about $6.0 million, or $0.04 a share, as a result of the March acquisition of Renaissance Hotel Group N.V. Excluding the impact of the acquisition, net income and earnings per share for the quarter were up 19 percent and 18 percent, respectively, from a year earlier, on sales growth of 15 percent.

For the first half of 1997, the company reported net income of $160 million and earnings per share of $1.18, both up 16 percent from the 1996 period. Sales totalled $5.482 billion, up 21 percent from the 1996 first half.
